backfill_options.description:
By default, energy data is backfilled from the start of your current billing cycle. You can optionally load 365 days of historical data.

**Note:** This decision cannot be changed later without deleting and re-adding the integration.
backfill_options.title: Historical Data

data_description.cost_mode: Your rate schedule number is printed on your Dominion Energy bill

cost_mode.description:
Select how energy costs are calculated. Your rate schedule number is printed on your Dominion Energy bill. If unsure, Rate 8 is the most common residential rate.

**Rate 2 note:** Rate 2 is available only to customers who have not exceeded 400 kWh in each of the prior 12 billing periods. Verify eligibility with Dominion before selecting this rate.

**Rate 7 note:** Only the time-of-use energy portion is calculated. The monthly demand charge cannot be determined from interval data.
cost_mode.title: Cost Calculation Settings

init.description:
Select how energy costs are calculated.

**Rate 2 note:** Rate 2 is available only to customers who have not exceeded 400 kWh in each of the prior 12 billing periods. Verify eligibility with Dominion before selecting this rate.

**Rate 7 note:** Only the time-of-use energy portion is calculated. The monthly demand charge cannot be determined from interval data.

**Note:** Daily and monthly fixed charges (Basic Facilities Charge, DER Program charge) are not included in cost statistics.
init.title: Cost Calculation Settings

recalculate_date_range.description: Enter the start and end dates for the historic cost recalculation. Dates must be in YYYY-MM-DD format and cannot be in the future.
recalculate_date_range.title: Select Recalculation Date Range

data_description.recalculate_history: If enabled, you will be asked to choose a date range for the recalculation

recalculate_history.description:
Your cost calculation method is changing from **{old_mode}** to **{new_mode}**.

Existing cost statistics were calculated using the old method. Would you like to recalculate historic cost records to use the new method?

NOTE:
- If changing to a rate schedule, cost calculation may not be completely accurate as billing cycles must be estimated
- Cost calculation will be limited to the effective date of the new rate schedule
recalculate_history.title: Recalculate Historic Costs?
